The '''Kalarath Imperial Encampment''' was an outpost operated by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] located in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Kalarath Imperial Encampment was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]].
